scope: Code-first metadata register. Raw observations and original receipts are not distributed in this release.
timestamp_policy: Observation, assumed availability and actual retrieval are separate. Missing receipt timestamps remain null, never inferred from file modification dates.

sources.permitted_use: Existing local public-source research; redistribution and empirical GitHub/ZIP inclusion not established here
